patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section with a dark overlay and centrally aligned content, followed by full-width content sections that alternate between light and dark backgrounds.
Elegant, slightly condensed serif font used for prominent headings and display text, contrasted with a clean, highly legible sans-serif for body copy and functional elements.
A sophisticated and restrained palette featuring deep, earthy greens and browns, warm off-whites, and crisp white text, creating a luxurious and grounded aesthetic.
The hero section's background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground text and interactive elements as the user scrolls down the page.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections that alternate between dark backgrounds with light text and light backgrounds with dark text, providing clear visual separation and rhythm.

technique_notes: Implement a full-bleed hero where the background image is fixed or scrolls at a slower rate than the main page content, creating a parallax effect, while the overlaid text and interactive elements scroll normally with the page flow.
Utilize a dark, semi-transparent overlay on background images within hero and content sections to ensure optimal contrast and readability for light-colored text.
Integrate video content within specific sections using an embedded player, often with a custom play button overlay, to showcase property features or brand stories.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body text) with a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy and uppercase for some labels, creating a sophisticated hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, while images and content blocks maintain sharp, defined edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy density, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable line-heights, contributing to an open and refined feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-quality, moody interior photography combined with a sophisticated, restrained color palette and elegant serif typography creates an immediate sense of luxury and refined taste, setting it apart from typical real estate sites.
